commands.title: List features
commands.description: List features: each feature's id, title, status, priority, problem and tags, filtered (every filter set must match), sorted (by id unless --sort-by says otherwise) and paged, with the total before paging.

args.name: status
args.description: Only features with this status: proposed (also a feature without one), accepted, in_progress, done, deferred or deprecated

args.name: priority
args.description: Only features with this priority: critical, high, medium, low

args.name: tags
args.description: Only features with at least one of these tags (comma-separated)

args.name: sort_by
args.description: The field to sort by (default id): id, title or a field a feature declares; ties by id

args.name: sort_order
args.description: asc (the default) or desc

args.name: limit
args.description: Return at most this many (default 100, clamped to 1-1000)

args.name: offset
args.description: Skip this many first (default 0)
